answer: Make every newcomer solve a dawn puzzle before it can trade: at each dawn, a beacon issues a sequential time-locked puzzle that takes hours of real computation and cannot be split across machines, so a farm cannot mint thousands of identities at once. Puzzles are handed out only through a narrow inlet, one per agent, and each solution binds to one key. The agent must then drift through a nebula of unrelated jobs, each verified by a different stranger. Sybil farms must queue at the inlet, solve a fresh puzzle, and redo real work for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
